decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program fits very closely with the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic capabilities, and another year of operating experience further strengthens its ability to refine and retain it.

Outpatient sociotherapy remains closely related to the firm's existing support and mental-health services, so its internal know-how and learning capacity make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the firm's eldercare offer and can be learned through its service network, but as a newer and more operationally demanding service it still carries a noticeably higher withdrawal risk than A or C.
